config.desc: Privacy notice or consent settings from siteConfig.privacyConsent. The component stores the visitor choice and emits qpress:privacy-consent for optional script or embed gating.

qpress:privacy-consent.desc: Browser CustomEvent dispatched on window after a saved privacy choice is read or written.

detail.desc: Stored consent id, accepted flag, category choices, savedAt, and optional expiresAt values.

savePrimaryChoice.desc: Stores the acknowledgement or accept-all choice.

rejectOptional.desc: Stores required categories only and rejects optional categories.
